name: MerchProduct
description: A product in the merch store. Printful products are pulled in by merch-admin's sync; manual products are ones the store owner ships themselves. Prices are always read from here at checkout, never from the browser.

key.description: Stable id within the product: pf-<sync variant id> for Printful, or a slug for manual products.

price.description: Selling price in USD. Set here; a Printful re-sync keeps it.

ship_first.description: Shipping for this option when it's the first item (overrides the product's). Empty = use the product's.

ship_additional.description: Shipping for this option as an extra item (overrides the product's).

pf_price_pending.description: Price changed here and not yet copied to Printful's listing.

price_from.description: Lowest available variant price, for listings.

ship_first.description: Shipping when this product is the first item in an order. Empty = store default.

ship_additional.description: Shipping for each extra unit of this product. Empty = store default.

ship_auto.description: Printful products: refresh shipping from Printful's current US rates every day. Off once an admin types their own rates.

ship_rates_updated_at.description: When the shipping rates were last pulled from Printful.

active.description: Shown in the store. New products start hidden until an admin reviews them.

printful_missing.description: Set when the product disappeared from Printful on the last sync.
